course_name_original: Atatürk's Principles and the History of the Turkish Revolution II
course_name_en: Atatürk's Principles and the History of the Turkish Revolution II

learning_outcomes.text: Understands the Atatürk reforms by delving into the historical roots of the Turkish revolution.
Drawing strength from Turkish history and the Turkish National Struggle, she/he stands up for her state and nation.
Accurately identifies internal and external threats directed at the Republic, secularism, and the Turkish nation, and becomes knowledgeable about these threats.
It develops policies tailored to them by getting to know Türkiye.
She/He is aware of the difficulties encountered during the establishment of the Grand National Assembly of Turkey.
Understands the challenges of the National Struggle.
It analyzes the terms of the Treaty of Sèvres.

syllabus_topics: Opening Turkish Grand National Assembly (TGNA) and its features
First activities of the TGNA and first codes
Reactions to TGNA, internal rebellions, opposite groups, the press in the National Struggle
National Struggle Fronts (east) and the Armenian Question
National Struggle Fronts (west), first occupations and national army
Establishment of regular army and financial sources of the National Struggle
Treaty of Sevres and its impact on Turkish Nation
Fronts in the National Struggle, Inonu I
Inonu II, Sakarya and Great Attack
Political aspect of National Struggle, Mudanya Armistice, Lozan Peace Conference, Foreign policy in the Ataturk period
Revolutions in the political, educational, cultural, jurisprudence and social fields
bibliography: Akvaryum Yayıncılık, Nutuk, 2005, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk
Der Yayınları, Türk İnkılap Tarihi, 2011, Ali İhsan Gencer-Sabahattin Özel
